failure.invariant: Every published checksum file names the downloadable release asset rather than an internal build path.
failure.trigger: The tag workflow hashes a chart using its dist/release path and publishes that record beside the chart basename.
failure.mechanism: sha256sum records the supplied internal path verbatim, so a consumer downloading the release assets into one directory cannot run the checksum file directly.
failure.impact: The chart bytes remain valid, but the dedicated public verification artifact fails for normal consumers and weakens the release-integrity workflow.

root.cause: The chart checksum was generated from the repository-root path instead of from within the chart output directory.
root.detection_gap: The workflow test checked that a checksum asset existed but did not replay it from the published flat asset layout.

refs: public v0.3.5 Helm checksum consumer smoke

replay.oracle: The same workflow contract test rejects the historical dist/release checksum entry and accepts a checksum whose recorded filename is the public chart basename.
